method_role: 28th benchmark-wide entrant and 16th eligible genetic-combination entrant after adding WitnessCell
primary_sota_rule: On the official primary top-100 panel, average the per-operation six-metric Rank over all four genetic-combination datasets and three split seeds; WitnessCell must rank ahead of all 15 published methods with eligible combination-track results.
secondary_robustness_rules: Repeat the per-operation aggregation on the 5,000-gene four-metric panel.
Report a dataset-equal-weight sensitivity analysis so that the larger Norman and Wessels test sets cannot silently dominate the interpretation.
mechanism_rule: WitnessCell must improve over its factorized-only ablation in at least 3 of 4 datasets and the gain must concentrate in combo_seen1/combo_seen2 rather than unseen_single/combo_seen0.
leakage_rule: Target outcomes are absent from fit_predict inputs and target-free deployment archives; official validation outcomes alone select alpha, kernel noise, and gamma.
claim_boundary: The formal SOTA claim is restricted to scPerturBench's genetic-combination track. The benchmark contains 27 methods overall, but only 15 published methods have eligible results in this track. Report the dataset-equal-weight sensitivity result and paired perturbation-cluster uncertainty beside the official point ranking.
